mapper.select: SELECT f.*, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS forum_comment_count, u.user_name FROM forum f LEFT JOIN comments c ON f.forum_id = c.forum_id left join user u on f.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY f.forum_id order by f.create_date desc limit #{offset},#{pageSize}
select * from forum where user_id = #{userId} order by create_date desc limit #{offset},#{pageSize}
select f.*,u.user_name,flu.status from forum f left join user u on f.user_id = u.user_id left join forum_like_user_relation flu on f.forum_id = flu.forum_id where f.forum_id = #{forumId}

SELECT f.*, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS forum_comment_count, u.user_name FROM forum f LEFT JOIN comments c ON f.forum_id = c.forum_id LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.forum_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{body}, '%') OR f.forum_body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{body}, '%') GROUP BY f.forum_id ORDER BY f.create_date DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select user_id from forum where forum_id = #{forumId}
select count(*) from forum WHERE forum_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{body}, '%') OR forum_body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{body}, '%')

select f.*,u.user_name,count(c.forum_id) as forum_comment_count from forum f join top_forum t on f.forum_id = t.forum_id join user u on f.user_id = u.user_id left join comments c on f.forum_id = c.forum_id group by f.forum_id order by create_date desc
